item.title: California Sea Lion and Brandt's Cormorant Spotted at Pillar Point Harbor
item.description:
California Sea Lion and Brandt’s Cormorant Spotted at Pillar Point Harbor

On 19th September 2026 at 10:10 AM, observers recorded marine wildlife at Pillar Point Harbor, CA, US.

🔍 Overview

  • Date: 19th September 2026
  • Time: 10:10 AM
  • Location: Pillar Point Harbor, California, USA

🐾 Species observed

  • California Sea Lion
  • Brandt’s Cormorant
  • Northern Gannet (named Morris) – noted peeking from behind the base of a sign after the photo was taken

📸 Observation details

Species Observation Detail
California Sea Lion Observed in harbor
Brandt’s Cormorant Observed in harbor
Northern Gannet (Morris) Peeking from behind sign after photo taken
